title: Alpha One — event user.registered v1
description: V1 catalog event `user.registered` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = NOT-01 (welcome), AUD, ANA-01. Derived from: docs/02 §4.1 (user.registered, AUTH-01) + docs/32 `identities` (id) / `identity_emails` (email_hash). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.

email_hash.description: sha256(normalised email) — the address itself never appears in an event payload (catalog note)
